title: ICAN A9 ride review
notes: Independent exact-frame review after about 200 km describes a size-52 A9 for a 177 cm / 70 kg / FTP 280 W rider as normally stiff rather than excessively stiff, with no lateral-wallow sensation when rocking the bike and smooth delay-free acceleration. The author explicitly says frame, wheels and other parts cannot be fully separated, so the evidence is qualitative and is not transferred to the retained complete-bike weight.
